general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: This course provides tools required to maintain sales and cost histories (the past), develop systems for monitoring current activities (the present), and the techniques required to anticipate what is to come (the future).
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by the instructor after class - Use laptop in class only for learning purposes - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.

description: This course provides tools required to maintain sales and cost histories (the past), develop systems for monitoring current activities (the present), and the techniques required to anticipate what is to come (the future).

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the income statement of an food and beverage business
Know how to develop a procedure to record current sales and develop a procedure to predict future sales.

Know how to use sales histories and standardized recipes to determine the amount of food products to purchase in a cost-effective manner, and implement proper procedures for receiving food and beverage products.
Understand how to implement an effective product storage and inventory system to control the issuing of products from storage and food and beverage production process
Understand how to accurately calculate food and beverage costs and their cost percentages for better controlling operation’s cost of sales and its cost of sales
Know how to choose the best menu format for a specific foodservice operation and Identify the variables to be considered when establishing menu prices.
Understand how to indentify the factors that affect employee productivity and to develop labor standards and employee schedules used in a foodservice operation.
Know how to classify and categorize other expenses in terms of being fixed, variable, or mixed to compute other expense costs in terms of cost per guest and as a percentage of sales
Know how to prepare income (profit and lost) statement to analyze sales and expese
Know how to analyze menu for profitability and create system to prevent internal and external threats to revenuue

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6, LO7, LO8, LO9, LO10
assessments.Question Type: Each student shoud make at least 1 individual presentation, case analysis during the course in front of the class. Topics will be varied based on the topics in the textbook.
assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. Class preparation and pre-reading before lecture will be assessed upon individuals' understanding and ability to answer questions in the class. Individuals will be called up randomly to be assessed.

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6, LO7, LO8, LO9, LO10
assessments.Question Type: Four or five students per group. Groups and groups ideas are determined on the third session of the course. Work will be break down into stages and examined during the course. Final work to be submitted prior to the presentation of the topic.
assessments.No Question: Minimum length of the group assignment should be 10 pages, excluding appendices
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on topics of studied units
assessments.Note: All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 11-point font, and must be submitted in both soft and hard copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission Evaluation will be based on both presentation and written report (reccommded 30%, 70% accordingly)

assessments.Question Type: Students solve cases and exercise of teacher
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Based on the given exercise or case study at the beginning of the course.

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6, LO7, LO8, LO9, LO10
assessments.Question Type: Multiple choice, exercises or essay questions
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Quizzes will test for knowledge of subjects in the chapter assigned for that day.
assessments.Note: These quizzes will be given at various times during class (beginning, middle or end). Total number of quizzes: 3 Quiz 1: LO1-3 Quiz 2: LO4-8 Quiz 3: LO9-10
